appName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and toolbar.

appShortName.description: Short name used when space is limited.

appDescription.message: Privacy-first Pomodoro timer: customizable timers, sound alerts, and focus-session site blocking. 100% local, no tracking.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

commandToggleTimer.message: Start, pause, or resume the OpenTomato timer
commandToggleTimer.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

common_restrictNote.message: 🔒 Restrictive mode — no skipping; reset only while paused.

common_resetConfirmPrompt.message: Restrictive mode is on. To reset the timer, type this exactly:

common_resetConfirmPhrase.message: Yes, I want to reset the timer.

options_subtitle.message: Customize your Pomodoro timer and focus-time site blocking.

options_restrictiveIntro.message: When restrictive mode is on, starting a focus session locks things down until that session ends:

options_restrictiveBullet1.message: Timer durations, idle detection, and every site-blocking setting are frozen.

options_restrictiveBullet2.message: The timer can't be skipped — at all.

options_restrictiveBullet3.message: The timer can only be reset while it's paused, and only after typing a confirmation phrase.
options_restrictiveBullet3.description: The <em> tag is intentional and should stay in the translation, wrapping whatever word means "paused" in this language.

options_restrictiveBullet4.message: Blocked pages lose their “Continue anyway” button.

options_restrictiveActiveNote.message: 🔒 A focus session is running — restrictive mode can't be changed until it ends.

options_lockedRestrictive.message: 🔒 Locked while a focus session is running (restrictive mode).

options_presetsIntro.message: Save the durations above as a named preset, then switch between presets here or from the popup instead of re-typing them.

options_soundOnEnd.message: Play a sound when a session ends

options_badgeCountdown.message: Show minutes remaining on the toolbar icon

options_warningEnabled.message: Warn me before a session ends

options_soundOnWarning.message: Play a sound for the warning

options_warningSecondsLabel.message: Warn me this many seconds before the end

options_idleEnable.message: Automatically pause when I'm away from the computer

options_idleMinutesLabel.message: Consider me away after this many minutes of inactivity

options_idleHint.message: Without this, the timer keeps running (and counting toward your focus total) even while you're away — this is what makes it notice and pause itself instead.

options_shortcutIntro.message: Start, pause, or resume the timer without opening the popup — whichever one of those makes sense for the timer's current state.

options_shortcutHint.message: Chrome manages keyboard shortcuts for every extension in one place, so changing it opens Chrome's own shortcuts page, scrolled to OpenTomato.

options_tasksIntro.message: A checklist that shows in the popup. Check items off from the popup or here; add, rename, remove, and drag to reorder them here. Give a task an estimate (in pomodoros) and mark it "active" — either here or from the popup — to auto-track completed sessions against it, no manual counting needed.

options_taskStartCrediting.message: Credit completed sessions to this task

options_taskStopCrediting.message: Stop crediting completed sessions to this task

options_confirmClearAllTasks.message: Remove all tasks? This can't be undone.

options_statsIntro.message: Counts the time you actually spend in focus sessions. Pick the window the popup's running total adds up over, or reset it whenever you want a fresh start.

options_confirmResetStats.message: Reset your focus total back to zero?

options_blockingHint.message: Blocking only applies during focus sessions — never during breaks. The blacklist and whitelist keep separate lists. Enter a domain (e.g. youtube.com) to match the whole site and its subdomains, or add a path to match just that section — e.g. reddit.com/r/funny leaves the rest of reddit.com reachable.
options_blockingHint.description: The ... spans wrap domain examples and should stay in the translation exactly as written (domains aren't translated); only the surrounding prose should be translated.

options_profilesIntro.message: Save the current mode and lists as a named profile (e.g. "Deep Work" vs "Light Research"), then switch between them here without re-editing your lists.

options_modeExplainerOff.message: Site blocking is off — every site is reachable during focus sessions.

options_modeExplainerBlacklist.message: Sites in the list below are blocked during focus sessions. Everything else is reachable.

options_modeExplainerWhitelist.message: Only sites in the list below are reachable during focus sessions. Everything else is blocked.

options_backupIntro.message: Export everything — settings, focus history, tasks, presets, and blocking profiles — to a JSON file you can keep as a backup or bring to another browser. Importing replaces your current data with what's in the file.

options_csvIntro.message: Or export just your focus-time log as a spreadsheet-friendly CSV file.

options_importNotBackup.message: That doesn't look like an OpenTomato backup file.

options_confirmImport.message: Import this backup? It will replace your current settings, focus history, tasks, presets, and blocking profiles.

options_confirmResetDefaults.message: Reset all OpenTomato settings to their defaults?

blocked_message.message: This site is off-limits while you're focusing.

blocked_hint.message: Head back to what you were working on — you've got this.

blocked_messageFree.message: Your focus session has ended — this page no longer applies.

notify_idlePaused.message: Paused — looks like you stepped away.

notify_idleResumed.message: Welcome back — resumed where you left off.
